description: A business that breaks even still brings its W-2 wages to an aggregation group (Schedule B line 3). Single, K-1 income $600,000, all in the main business; listed business 2 has $0 QBI and pays $400,000 of W-2 wages, and both are in group 1. The group: QBI $600,000, W-2 wages $400,000 → 20% = $120,000, wage limit $200,000 → $120,000. Taxable income $600,000 − $15,750 = $584,250 caps it at 20% = $116,850.
